categories.main_business_segments: ResMed operates in two primary business segments: Sleep and Respiratory Care, which includes devices, masks, accessories, and diagnostic products for sleep apnea, COPD, and other respiratory disorders; and Software as a Service (SaaS), which provides cloud-based software solutions for out-of-hospital healthcare providers, including home medical equipment, home health, hospice, skilled nursing, and senior living facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include cloud-connected CPAP, APAP, bilevel, and ventilation devices, advanced mask systems, and digital health platforms for remote patient monitoring and engagement. Manufacturing is globally distributed, with facilities in the US, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and France, focusing on quality, cost control, and supply chain resilience. SaaS offerings are developed through proprietary software platforms and integrations, supported by ongoing R&D and acquisitions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ResMed’s primary customers are home healthcare dealers, sleep clinics, hospitals, and out-of-hospital care providers such as HME/DME companies, skilled nursing, and senior living facilities. End markets include patients with sleep apnea, COPD, asthma, neuromuscular disease, and other chronic respiratory conditions, as well as healthcare professionals and caregivers managing out-of-hospital care.
categories.geographic_coverage: ResMed sells products in over 140 countries, with major operations in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company has significant manufacturing and sales presence in the US, Australia, Singapore, Germany, China, Malaysia, and France, and its SaaS business operates primarily in the US and Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: ResMed operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, designing, manufacturing, and distributing finished medical devices, masks, accessories, and software solutions directly to healthcare providers, distributors, and end users. The company also provides direct-to-patient services in select markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: ResMed’s strategic priorities include ongoing innovation in sleep apnea and respiratory care products, expansion of digital health and cloud-based platforms, growth of SaaS solutions in out-of-hospital care, and geographic expansion in high-growth regions. R&D efforts focus on improving patient outcomes, enhancing device connectivity, developing new clinical applications, and integrating data-driven insights from real-world evidence and clinical trials.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical devices (CPAP, APAP, ventilators), masks, accessories, and diagnostic products, as well as recurring revenue from SaaS subscriptions and software licensing for healthcare providers. Additional revenue streams include extended warranties, service contracts, and direct patient services in select regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ResMed’s main competitors in Sleep and Respiratory Care include Philips BV, Fisher & Paykel Healthcare, DeVilbiss Healthcare, Apex Medical, BMC Medical, React Health, and Lowenstein, as well as regional and new-entrant manufacturers. In SaaS, competition is intense and rapidly evolving, with many customers using in-house or alternative software solutions. ResMed is positioned as a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected respiratory care.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, ResMed reported net revenue of $4.22 billion, up 18% from the prior year, with net income of $898 million and gross profit of $2.36 billion. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, driven by increased demand, geographic expansion, and acquisitions, and maintains a strong balance sheet with $6.75 billion in total assets and $4.13 billion in stockholders’ equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ResMed differentiates itself through its integrated ecosystem of cloud-connected devices, digital health platforms, and SaaS solutions that enable remote monitoring, patient engagement, and improved clinical outcomes. The company emphasizes innovation, patient comfort, adherence to therapy, and operational efficiencies for providers, offering a comprehensive suite of products and services that support the shift to out-of-hospital and home-based care.
